# Jeremy Collins

> Software engineer at Webflow in Los Angeles. Makes Codable, Taktung, TabForge, and Paper & Grain for iPhone and iPad.

Optional: [full summary](https://jeremycollins.net/llms-full.txt)

## About

Jeremy Collins is a senior software engineer at Webflow. His recent work is growth engineering: billing, usage metering, paywalls, and customer-facing product. His independent apps include Codable for web development, Taktung for Vercel deployments, TabForge for typing code, and Paper & Grain for origami.

## FAQ

- Who is Jeremy Collins? A senior software engineer at Webflow in Los Angeles. He works on growth engineering and makes apps for iPhone and iPad.
- What is Codable? A free iOS app with Safari-native web developer tools: inspector, console, network monitor, scratchpad, and viewport tester. No ads or tracking.
- What is Taktung? A free iOS app for Vercel deploy and incident ops. Site health, deploys, confirmed promote or rollback. Token stays on the phone. Not affiliated with Vercel.
- What is TabForge? A free, open-source programming keyboard for iPhone and iPad with coding punctuation, indentation, snippets, and input profiles. No Full Access required.
- What is Paper & Grain? Close an iPhone Duo to fold the paper; device folding requires iOS 27.1 or later. A free origami puzzle game for iPhone and iPad with eight lessons, Free Fold, and saved editable creations. No timer or losing. Requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. Touch controls work without a folding device.
- Where does Jeremy Collins work? Webflow.

## Apps

- [Codable on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/codable/id1324741659): Safari-native inspector, console, network monitor, scratchpad, and viewport tester for iOS
- [Taktung on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/taktung/id6805738660): Vercel deploy and incident ops on iPhone. Site health, deploys, confirmed promote or rollback
- [TabForge on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tabforge-code-keyboard/id6824056795): free, open-source programming keyboard with punctuation, indentation, snippets, and input profiles
- [Paper & Grain on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/paper-grain/id6821361967): close an iPhone Duo to fold the paper; free origami puzzle game with eight lessons and Free Fold
